# sebaro Blueprint

> The design guide of every sebaro app, website, web app, desktop app and browser extension: the 31 core rules, the view types, one concept page per part, the rules per platform type, components and data display. German UI language (du). Technology plans and starters live in the private workshop.

Machine-readable rules: https://grundhofer.github.io/sebaro-blueprint/rules.json · Agent entry: https://github.com/grundhofer/sebaro-blueprint/blob/main/AGENTS.md

## Building a product

- [Core rules](https://github.com/grundhofer/sebaro-blueprint/blob/main/design/KERN.md) and [view types](https://github.com/grundhofer/sebaro-blueprint/blob/main/design/views.md): the 31 rules and 21 view types to read before any UI work
- [Platform types](https://github.com/grundhofer/sebaro-blueprint/tree/main/design/platforms): what holds for a phone app, a website, a web app, a desktop app or a browser extension beyond the core rules
- [Parts](https://github.com/grundhofer/sebaro-blueprint/tree/main/design/parts): one concept page per part
- [Playbooks](https://github.com/grundhofer/sebaro-blueprint/blob/main/skills/sebaro/SKILL.md): start a new product or convert an existing project, as an agent skill
- [Agent snippet](https://github.com/grundhofer/sebaro-blueprint/blob/main/skills/sebaro/AGENTS-snippet.md): the section to paste into the product's AGENTS.md
- [Screen checklist](https://github.com/grundhofer/sebaro-blueprint/blob/main/design/checklist.md): walk it before a screen is done; the product's CHECKS.md holds only what no check sees and every waiver with its reason (TEC-06)

## Pages

- [Start](https://grundhofer.github.io/sebaro-blueprint/index.html): Einstieg: was sebaro ist, die 31 Kernregeln auf Deutsch, was je Produktart dazukommt
- [Bauteile](https://grundhofer.github.io/sebaro-blueprint/bauteile.html): Alle Komponenten mit Zuständen und Markup
- [Daten](https://grundhofer.github.io/sebaro-blueprint/daten.html): Jede Datenart einmal dargestellt: Text, Zahlen, Zeit, Status, Listen, Tabellen, Diagramme, Code …

## System files (generated, never edit)

- [tokens.css](https://grundhofer.github.io/sebaro-blueprint/sebaro/tokens.css): every --sb-* custom property, light and dark
- [sebaro.css](https://grundhofer.github.io/sebaro-blueprint/sebaro/css/sebaro.css): reference components (sb-*)
- [sprite.svg](https://grundhofer.github.io/sebaro-blueprint/sebaro/icons/sprite.svg): icon sprite
- [fonts.css](https://grundhofer.github.io/sebaro-blueprint/sebaro/fonts/fonts.css): self-hosted sebaro Sans + sebaro Mono
